_comment: CI STUB — placeholder values only, no real credentials.
The real android/app/google-services.json is gitignored. CI copies this in
so the com.google.gms.google-services plugin can run during a compile-only
build. package_name MUST match applicationId in android/app/build.gradle.kts
or the plugin fails with 'No matching client found for package name'.
An APK built with this cannot reach Firebase and must never be distributed.
